description:
Situated in a high-demand area on a desirable corner lot, this 4-bedroom, 2-bath home offers strong curb appeal, a functional layout, and an inviting outdoor setting. The backyard is a true highlight, featuring a covered patio and a beautiful waterfall that creates a private, relaxing oasis—perfect for both everyday enjoyment and entertaining.

Inside, the home features thoughtful upgrades throughout, with additional areas that provide opportunity for personalization and added value. The living room centers around a fireplace with white-painted brick, bringing a clean, modern touch while still maintaining warmth. The kitchen includes a new double oven and dishwasher, adding modern convenience and functionality.

Blending comfort, potential, and standout outdoor living, this home is well-positioned in one of the area’s most desirable pockets.
